layers.name: app
layers.purpose: Entry point (src/main.tsx) and page layout (src/App.tsx) that put the components together; may import every lower layer.

layers.name: components
layers.purpose: React UI, one folder per component; may import utils, context, types but never another component folder.

layers.name: utils
layers.purpose: Helpers (URL state sharing, icon wrapper, expand/collapse animation); may import context and types.

layers.name: context
layers.purpose: AppStateContext, the central app state; may import only types.

layers.name: types
layers.purpose: Shared domain types; imports nothing else from src.
